description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle database data tier to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including photo storage and managed identity authentication.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC configuration, SQL, schema, and BLOB data types, and stores database credentials in plaintext. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service, with managed identity as the planned authentication method.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL JDBC driver. Update Spring datasource configuration and the Hibernate dialect for PostgreSQL, and update application.properties and application-docker.properties to use the Azure Database for PostgreSQL endpoint and managed identity authentication instead of plaintext credentials. Convert Oracle-specific SQL and schema definitions to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, including converting photo BLOB storage to bytea.
